note: Uncommitted experiment, measured and reverted. On one profiled fetch, record parsing was about 8 ms and moving those records into FetchedRecord was about 14 ms. Delivering uncompressed, non-transactional batches straight into the output vector skipped the intermediate record vector. Twenty interleaved pairs: paired mean records/s ratio 1.036, bootstrap 95% CI 1.009 to 1.063. The interval excludes zero and the mean is above 3%, but the lower bound is 0.9%, so the 3% bar is not established. Allocation count fell from 135,370 to 135,100. Allocated bytes fell from 51,649,211 to 37,609,211 on every run. The code was not kept.
